descriptions.g6b_archive_directory_801f8838: Scans a stream backwards for the ZIP end signature, reads and decodes its central directory, allocates64-byte entry records and normalizes backslashes in entry names. Complete24-byte end and48-byte central local records cover every observed helper write. Partial archive/stream objects remain external views. The information and byte-count output schemas are provisional pending concrete virtual-callee footprint confirmation. Not a readiness claim; names inferred.
